svg.title: MARS architecture and scientific workflow: research objectives to human-approved actions
svg.desc: Two bands. Top, the scientific workflow as a loop: a research objective in natural language becomes a measurement plan; a person approves it; MARS sends an instrument-agnostic observing request to Skynet 2, which matches, schedules and observes on its telescopes; the returned data are analysed with validated tools and checked for scientific adequacy; a person accepts the result or a follow-up, which starts the loop again. Bottom, the MARS engine that carries out each step: a language model from any provider proposes tool calls to a bounded, interruptible agent loop that proposes, validates, approves, executes and observes each call; 55 validated astronomy tools for planning, analysis and catalogs and archives, also served over MCP to other AI agents; a session record of every call; and an evaluation harness of 144 recorded sessions over 3 models with deterministic grading. Dashed outlines are to be built in Aim 2.
